Samir —

Thanks for the note and great context. We can definitely keep things moving. High-level options I can offer today (we can formalize in an amendment once you pick a path):

1) 30-day timebox extension (preferred for speed)
   - Maintain current environment, increase concurrency to 12 for the extension window.
   - Price: $4,500 flat for the 30-day extension (covers burst capacity and support), OR a 20% discount if you prepay using a credit voucher.

2) 14-day bridge + paid run (low friction)
   - First 14 days free (we absorb minor infra cost), then a paid 30-day top-up billed on actual usage based on the attached pricing_grid.xlsx.

3) Convert-to-commit pathway (for productization teams)
   - 6-month pilot commit: committed capacity + priority routing, discounted rate compared to on-demand. We can include a rollout SLA and quarterly review.

I attached the usage snapshot you requested (ClearSight_usage_june.csv) and a draft SOW (POC_SOW_v1.pdf) that sketches the extended scope/options.

If you’re comforted by a low-risk approach, option #2 tends to be the fastest to approve internally. If you want to keep negotiating pricing, we can also do a hybrid: 14 days free, then a shortened paid 30-day timebox at a small discount.

cc: Marissa for pricing approval and Vanessa for capacity ops.
